acknowledged.thm:support-transition: Delivered cardinality result: it identifies the certified transition between optimal three-output and five-output stationary releases and is a substantive headline implication even though no later proof consumes it.
acknowledged.thm:laplace-comparison: Delivered benchmark result: it quantifies the interval-length comparison with the published custom-Laplace estimator and belongs as an endpoint of the paper's comparator section.
acknowledged.thm:sequential-minimax: Central delivered theorem: it states the exact sequential local asymptotic minimax bound and private-pilot attainment, so it is the paper's main conclusion rather than a helper for another frozen result.
acknowledged.def:sequential-channels: Necessary reader-facing setup: it defines the sequential locally private procedure class quantified over by the main minimax theorem.
acknowledged.def:sequential-vt-handle: Necessary proof apparatus: it introduces the selected direction and smooth prior used to explain the sequential van Trees lower-bound mechanism in the proof appendix.
acknowledged.def:oa-release: Necessary benchmark definition: it specifies the published custom-Laplace release and estimator evaluated by thm:laplace-comparison.
